thesis.infer: Price down with BTC OI up and funding at the floor suggests new shorts pressing rather than long leverage unwinding; the move tracks tech (BTC -3.9%, QQQ -2.71%), so we read it as macro-driven. Consensus is pricing a calm regime (VIX under 20, F&G 68); we read the risk as a lagging sentiment gauge catching down to a hawkish backdrop (10Y 5.12%, Brent $115). The disagreement is stretched sentiment against a Restrictive Macro lens.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops around the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close back above $81.7K keeps the hl-cycles regime intact, and a daily close below it is the stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.2K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play, more likely with a hawkish surprise or a VIX close above 25. Second tail case (low-confidence): short covering with price reclaiming $81.7K may follow if BTC OI keeps rising against flat funding; consensus is pricing continued calm, we read squeeze risk as a bit below even odds.
